source: canonical SemanticQueryPlan audit over the 16 representable oracle cases

ownership.MODEL_LOGICAL_DECISION: The value depends on user meaning and cannot be uniquely derived by the server.
ownership.SERVER_DERIVABLE: The value is uniquely derived from logical decisions and server metadata.
ownership.SERVER_POLICY: The server applies a safety or inclusion policy; the model does not select mechanics.
ownership.CANONICAL_BOOKKEEPING: Runtime output/scoping metadata, not user intent.
ownership.OBSERVABILITY_ONLY: Useful for diagnostics but not part of the model contract.
